INDIA bloc holds Ramlila Maidan rally amid claims of large turnout

Leaders of the INDIA bloc held a rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan, with one report claiming a "lakhs" (hundreds of thousands) of people gathered. The event saw leaders taking to the streets from Minto Road to the rally site. The rally occurred amid reported unease from the Modi government.
